Q: How to open .MD file in gitbash? A:

If you want to open .MD file from Vscode click on it to open, or you can open it from terminal by using this command:

code README.md

If you want to open .md in terminal you can using vim or nano,vim work in Linux, Mac and Windows but nano work in linux

vim REAADME.md

OR

nano README.md

You can open preview mode by using this shortcut open the file and press from keyboard:

Shift + Ctrl + v

Q: GROUP BY using spotfire A:

At first you need to add a calculated column to keep only one row per project:

[unique spend]: If(Min(RowId()) OVER ([Project Name])=RowId(), [Project Spend], null)

Then create you line chart and use this expression for vertical axis:

Sum([unique spend]) over (AllPrevious([Axis.X]))

Q: Handling of Negative Exponent in Recursion, Confused A:

quote I think you meant to check if base was 0, then return 0 .... why ?

(±0)^(±0) := 1

One might bring up the point mentioned on wiki how some mathematicians argue it should be 0, based on limits approach. The biggest issue with that approach is this -

(±0)^(+0) := ±0 (assumption of hypothesis)

(±0)^(-0) = 1 /        (±0)^(+0)
          = 1 / (±0 := (±0)^(+0))
          = 1 / (±0)

          = ±Inf

So we ended up with drastically different outcomes by simply flipping sign of zero, which isn't supposed to be any different since (+0) == (-0). Zero has no sign at all, and zero is also simultaneously both signs.
